judgment_text:
Prayer : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue a writ of certiorarified Mandamus to call for the records pertaining to G.O.(D) No. 77 Higher Education (H1) Department dated 27-5-2020 issued by the 1st respondent and the consequent proceedings No. 37095/A2/2016, dated 6-6-2020 issued by the 4th respondent and quash the same and consequently direct the respondents to post the petitioner in his Parent Department, Viz, 3rd respondent University

ORDER

Ms Karen Vania. S, learned counsel representing Mr Richardson Wilson learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is not interested to pursue the writ petition and instructed to withdraw the writ petition.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that a memo dated 28-10-2025 has been filed seeking to withdraw the writ petition enclosing therewith a copy of the letter dated 15-10-2025 received from the petitioner. She also made an endorsement to that effect on the case bundle.

3. Recording the memo dated 28-10-2025 and the endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn.

No costs. Consequently connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
